svg.text: One result with its resolution (mock of the Results entry and the 3D view)
From the runs by oneresult.mjs. Glyphs: resolution level. Blue: the solid at its values; orange dashed: the lateral range; cones 95 %.
box-plate110 (seed 1)
truth: box 12 × 10 × 2 nm
●●○ partly resolved
Plate — partly resolved: thickness and normal, lateral sizes.
Thickness (column length along the normal): 1.99 nm (1.93–2.05).
Normal: [110], within 9.8° (95 %).
Lateral: 8.96–14.3 nm; the in-plane shape and edges not resolved.
Aspect (lateral/thickness): 4.4–7.4.
Size over all directions: 4.57 nm (4.43–4.76) as one sphere's diameter,
the isotropic fit's reading.
Solid (compared): not determined, 5 of 6 fit within ΔBIC 25. The lengths
above are the same for each.
Drawn: the box 11.7 × 9.93 × 1.99 nm, held on the lattice.
free about the normal
solid at its estimates; dashed: lateral range
sph-prolate111 (seed 1)
truth: spheroid 5 × 5 × 25 nm
●●○ partly resolved
Needle — partly resolved: section and axis, length.
Length (column length along the axis): 17.4 nm (14.9–20.9).
Section: 3.62–3.88 nm; its shape not resolved.
Size over all directions: 6.23 nm (6.05–6.46) as one sphere's diameter,
the isotropic fit's reading.
Solid (compared): not determined, 6 of 6 fit within ΔBIC 25. The lengths
above are the same for each.
Drawn: the spheroid 4.99 × 4.99 × 23.2 nm, held on the lattice.
section: free about the axis
solid at its estimates; dashed: section range
u09 (seed 1)
truth: box 10 × 22 × 2.5 nm
●○○ partly resolved
Plate — partly resolved: thickness and normal.
Thickness (column length along the normal): 2.32 nm (2.23–2.41).
Normal: [110] 9° off, within 2.6° (95 %).
Lateral: over 11.0 nm; the in-plane shape and edges not resolved.
Aspect (lateral/thickness): over 4.6.
Size over all directions: 5.68 nm (4.99–5.88) as one sphere's diameter,
the isotropic fit's reading.
Background: degree 18 chosen by BIC over 6 and 12 (χ²_ν 1.05 → 0.99). Over
these degrees the thickness reads 2.11–2.32 nm: the model, more than the
noise, sets it.
Solid (compared): not determined, 6 of 6 fit within ΔBIC 25. The lengths
above are the same for each.
Drawn: the box 15.8 × 34.5 × 2.32 nm.
free about the normal
solid at its estimates; dashed: lateral lower limit (open above)
